record.one_liner: Gladly is a customer service platform (agent desk, chat, customer profiles) with a REST API for customer data and timelines.
record.auth_notes: Basic Auth: username is the agent email, password is an API token created in Gladly Settings. Per the rubric, a token sent as the Basic-auth password is api_key. critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: API tokens require an existing Gladly org where an admin grants the API User permission (Settings > Users). No free developer signup, sandbox or public API pricing found; demo-led sales. A 30-day free trial is advertised only for the Shopify AI chatbot product, not for API access. critic: access contact_sales confirmed, medium confidence.
record.api_notes: Docs cover customer profiles, conversations, timeline items, tasks, and messaging. Full object coverage not verified.
record.blocker_notes: Needs a Gladly customer org with admin-granted API User permission before any token exists. Official Gladly-hosted MCP is for Gladly org users only. Community MCPs also exist (Cotlet on Glama). critic: confirmed.

evidence.quote: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication. API tokens are associated with designated Gladly users.
